Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Mohd. Safdar, learned counsel
for the applicants.
2. Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, learned Additional
Advocate General along with Mr. S.C.
Dumka, learned A.G.A. and Mr. Nikhil
Bisht, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. By means of the present anticipatory
bail application, the applicant seeks grant
of anticipatory bail in the event of their
arrest in connection with FIR/Case Crime
No. 219 of 2026, under Sections 3/5 read
with Section 11 of the Uttarakhand
Protection of Cow Progeny Act, 2007, at
Police Station Bhagwanpur, District
Haridwar.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant
would submit that the impugned FIR has
been lodged on the allegation that during
patrolling duty, the police received
information that applicant along with
certain other persons, had allegedly
slaughtered cow progeny and was storing
and distributing beef on the spot. It is
further alleged that thereafter the police

UKHC010135212026
2026:UHC:7074
conducted a raid at the spot and allegedly
recovered approximately 150 kilograms of
alleged beef along with equipment and the
recovered material was thereafter
inspected and sampled by the Veterinary
Officer and, on the basis thereof, the
present FIR came to be registered.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant
would further submit that the applicant is
innocent and has falsely been implicated
in the present case; that, the applicant
was not present at the spot at the time of
the alleged recovery; that, no
incriminating recovery has been affected
from the possession of the present
applicant; that, there is no FSL report to
prove that the alleged recovered meat is a
cow beef.
6. Per contra, learned State Counsel
would oppose the anticipatory bail
application and submitted that a
substantial quantity of alleged beef has
been recovered from the house of the
applicant during the raid conducted by
the police and the investigation is still in
progress.
7. At this stage, learned counsel for the
applicant would submit that the applicant
is ready and willing to surrender before
the court concerned and seeks permission
to withdraw the present anticipatory bail
application with liberty to surrender
before the competent court within a
reasonable period and seek regular bail. It
is further prayed that till such surrender,
the applicant may be granted protection
from arrest.

UKHC010135212026
2026:UHC:7074
8. Learned State Counsel has no
objection to the aforesaid prayer.
9. Heard learned counsel for the parties
and perused the material available on
record.
10. Considering the facts and
circumstances of the case and the
statement made on behalf of the
applicant, the present anticipatory bail
application is dismissed as withdrawn
with liberty to the applicant to surrender
before the court concerned on or before
11.09.2026 and seek appropriate relief in
accordance with law.
11. Till 11.09.2026 or till the date of
surrender, whichever is earlier, the
applicant shall not be arrested in
connection with Case Crime/F.I.R. No.
219 of 2026, under Sections 3/5 read with
Section 11 of the Uttarakhand Protection
of Cow Progeny Act, 2007, at Police
Station Bhagwanpur, District Haridwar,
provided that the applicant cooperates
with the investigation and makes himself
available before the Investigating Officer
as and when required.
12. It is made clear that in the event the
applicant fails to cooperate with the
investigation or fails to surrender before
the court concerned on or before
11.09.2026, the interim protection granted
by this Court shall automatically stand
vacated without any further order.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 11.08.2026 Mamta
